tutorial_1_description:
Zusam is a private forum for your friends or family.

This tutorial will show you around some of the key features.
tutorial_2_description:
All content in Zusam is posted to a group. You can only see content from groups you have been invited into.

Here you can see a list of groups you have access to. You can also invite other people into any group you have access to.
tutorial_3_description: The group page shows all the content posted to the group. You can also choose to invite others to the group or leave the group.
tutorial_4_description:
Click this button to post a message to this group.

Anyone with access to this group will see your message.
tutorial_5_description: While you can look at each group individually, most of the time you'll probably want to view your feed.
tutorial_6_description: Your feed shows posts from all of the groups you have access to, sorted by the most recent activity. If someone replies to a post, that post will jump to the top so you can always find recent activity.
tutorial_8_description: Click here to react to a post.
tutorial_10_description: You can go to the group by clicking here
tutorial_11_description: Or head back to your feed
tutorial_12_description: Head to your settings page to upload a profile picture or edit your name, invite some friends on the invite page, and don't forget to enjoy yourself!
you_are_last_group_will_delete: You are the only member of this group. If you leave, the group will be deleted.
you_will_need_invite: You will need an invite to join again.
